perks.name: Ride Together, Die Together
perks.description: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.
perks.exact:
On Orb of Power Pickup:
Grants Ride Together, Die Together for 3 seconds.
Ride Together, Die Together initially grants 40% [5%] Damage Resist.
Damage Resist scales down to ~30?% with 1.5 seconds left, further reduced to 24?% with 1 second left, decreasing down to 0% over the remaining second.

perks.name: Too Old for This
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.
perks.exact:
On Elite+ Finisher:
Restores 32 HP and +16% Special Ammo Progress.

archetype.name: Powerhouse
archetype.description:
Armor configured for Guardians that take the word "impossible" as a challenge.

Primary Stat: Weapons
Secondary Stat: Super

item.name: +Class / -Health
item.description: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Health stat.

item.name: +Class / -Health
item.description: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Health stat.

item.name: Weapons Font
item.description: Collecting an Orb of Power causes you to gain 1 temporary Armor Charge.
item.exact:
While Armor Charge is active:

+20 | +40 | +50 Weapons.

item.name: Arc Scavenger
item.description: Arc weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
item.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup to Mod-Element Matching Weapons:
Generally grants an additional +1 Ammo.

Machine Guns receive +7 Ammo.
Traces receive +10% Max Reserves.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of Reserves.
Works with Ammo Finder Bricks in full effect.

Does not function in PvP Game Modes.
